news.title: Who decides what AI tells you? Campbell Brown, once Meta’s news chief, has thoughts
news.description: "The conversation is sort of happening in Silicon Valley around one thing, and a totally different conversation is happening among consumers."

news.title: Clio’s $500M milestone arrives just as Anthropic ups the ante
news.description: Legal tech startups, including Clio, which just hit $500 million in ARR, are seeing massive customer adoption.

news.title: Notion just turned its workspace into a hub for AI agents
news.description: Notion’s new developer platform lets teams connect AI agents, external data sources, and custom code directly into their workspace as the company pushes deeper into agentic productivity software.

news.title: Musk’s xAI is running nearly 50 gas turbines unchecked at its Mississippi data center
news.description: Gas turbines at xAI's Colossus 2 data center have drawn a lawsuit over the company's use of "mobile" gas turbines as power plants.

news.title: Anthropic’s Cat Wu says that, in the future, AI will anticipate your needs before you know what they are
news.description: The head of product for Claude Code and Cowork says that the next big step for AI is proactivity.

news.title: HMRC to use AI from British tech firm to spot fraud and tax return errors
news.description: Quantexa, a financial data platform, won the £175m contract to spot fraud and tax return errors.

news.title: WhatsApp launches totally private 'incognito' conversations with its AI chatbot
news.description: A cyber security expert says deleting chat history could lead to a lack of accountability if things go wrong.

news.title: What It Will Take to Make AI Sustainable
news.description: Researcher Sasha Luccioni argues we need better emissions data and a better sense of how people are using AI in the first place.
